evals.name: territory-summary-eval-1
evals.expected_output: North has 3 accounts, 3 open deals, 161000 open. South has 3 accounts, 4 open deals, 217000. West has 3 accounts, 2 open deals, 49000. North is concentrated (Alder Freight is 74.5 percent). South is concentrated (Elm Logistics is 69.1 percent). West is not (Holt Textiles is 61.2 percent). Quiet accounts: Fir Health 120 days (no open deal), Cobalt Dental 95 (no open deal), Dunmore Retail 52 (one open deal).
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
North and South are flagged for concentration with the shares computed
Fir Health, Cobalt Dental and Dunmore Retail are listed as quiet, ranked by days
The summary does not say a territory is unfair or needs rebalancing

evals.name: territory-summary-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run territory-summary on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
